redaction_policy.stdout: redact secrets, tokens, prompts, and account material before artifact publication
redaction_policy.stderr: redact secrets, tokens, prompts, and account material before artifact publication
redaction_policy.env: env var names only; values remain in operator-owned secret store
redaction_policy.artifacts: raw artifacts reviewed by operator, redacted copies only

timeouts.kill_policy: hard timeout kills process tree and records redacted stop reason

budget.stop_policy: stop immediately on first unexpected spend, login failure, or unredacted output

cli.command_plan: codex exec --json with approved fixture prompt; do not execute in this gate
